events.title: Playtest is now open! 🛻

The playtest is part of the Steam PvE Survival & Crafting Fest, and it comes with a new trailer! The scenario mode builds on the true and tested sandbox experience loved by tens of thousands of playtesters and many content creators like Biffmatic and Camodo Gaming. events.title: New patch v0.11.7 is live for playtesters!
events.summary: The world outside the windshield has stopped being one thing. This update brings biomes to Arctic Drive: new vegetation, rocks and tree stumps, and roads that narrow or widen depending on where you've ended up. POI distribution has been reworked so you hit a better mix of small stops and big finds. events.title: Devlog #3 - The Snow in Arctic Drive
events.summary: Snow is most of what you look at in Arctic Drive, so it deserved our attention, now that we prepare for the next beta phases. We replaced the whole thing with our own system. We call it PurrSnow , and it's running behind the scenes for testing now.What changedThe snow is a real surface now, and everything interacts with it:Wheels carve actual trenches.
